name: GPU Instancing with Indirect Draw Calls
aliases: GPU Instanced Voxel Rendering via DrawMeshInstancedIndirect
definition: A technique to render a large number of identical meshes (voxels) efficiently by using indirect draw calls. Instead of issuing one draw call per instance, a single draw call is issued that reads instance counts and parameters from a GPU-accessible buffer (GraphicsBuffer), allowing the GPU to generate the draw commands itself.
summary: GPU Instancing with Indirect Draw Calls efficiently renders millions of voxels by letting the GPU generate draw commands from a buffer, avoiding CPU overhead and rasterizing explicit geometry instead of implicit surfaces or splats.
